elementKinds.label: Software System
elementKinds.description: The system in scope, or another internal system (System / SystemDb / SystemQueue).

elementKinds.label: External System
elementKinds.description: A system outside the scope being described (System_Ext / SystemDb_Ext / SystemQueue_Ext).

c4-context.guidance: A C4 System Context diagram shows the software system in scope, the people who use it, and the other systems it depends on -- nothing inside a system (no containers or components). Every relationship needs a label describing what it does.

elementKinds.label: Primary Activity
elementKinds.description: An activity that directly creates and delivers value: inbound logistics, operations, outbound logistics, marketing & sales, service. Chain them left to right in the order value flows.

elementKinds.label: Support Activity
elementKinds.description: An activity that enables the primary activities across the whole chain: firm infrastructure, human resource management, technology development, procurement. Not connected into the primary flow.

elementKinds.label: Margin
elementKinds.description: The value captured: exactly one, at the end of the primary activity chain.

value-chain.guidance: Porter's value chain: primary activities in sequence left to right (typically 5: inbound logistics, operations, outbound logistics, marketing & sales, service), the last one feeding the single Margin element. Support activities (typically 4: firm infrastructure, HR management, technology development, procurement) sit as bands above the primary chain and are not connected into it.
